content.text: Cameron, a North West Mounted Police officer, pursues the Sioux agitator Copperhead amid rising Indigenous unrest and the 1885 Rebellion. Copperhead repeatedly escapes, but Cameron and Jerry eventually capture him after Cameron is imprisoned and freed by the grateful Indian boy he once helped. Raven, an outlaw, saves Cameron’s sister Moira and dies thwarting a cattle stampede; Moira later chooses Dr. Martin. Cameron’s patrol work helps keep Crowfoot and the Blackfeet loyal, while the Police and Canadian forces suppress the rebellion. The text then abruptly shifts to the Rover boys’ Congo expedition: Dan Baxter joins Captain Villaire, captures Randolph and Dick at a jungle hostelry, but Sam, Tom, Aleck, and Cujo rescue them at an abandoned fort. The expedition continues through storms and dangerous jungle.
